name: Shipping tier
purpose: choose how an order ships from its weight, distance and membership. Send membership, weight, distance or items, separated by spaces; it answers standard, express, freight or refused, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: ST-01: the app always answers freight when weight is above 30000. ST-02: the app never answers express when weight is above 30000. ST-03: the app never answers express when membership is none and weight is at most 30000 and items is at most 50.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  weight is above 30000 → freight
  membership is platinum → express
  membership is gold and distance is at most 500 → express
  items is above 50 → refused
  otherwise → standard
proposition.plain: choose how an order ships from its weight, distance and membership.
